environment.description: Staging deployment on AWS ECS with Split.io SDK configured against the 'staging_v3' environment. The feature flag 'search-rich-preview-v2' has a kill switch activated via Split's targeting rules: the flag definition in this workspace has status 'killed' with default treatment 'off' and no individual/segment targeting overrides. The kill was applied on 2024-11-15 following SR-2024-0891. Note: the Split SDK's getTreatment() returns 'control' (which maps to the hardcoded default=false) if the flag definition is in killed state, regardless of any user attributes or segment membership. The application's FeatureFlagService.evaluate() method returns the $default parameter (false) when treatment is neither 'on' nor 'off', which covers the 'control' treatment returned for killed flags.
